findings.title: Funding not declared for several fresh-session cases
findings.problem: coworkFundingSource returns undefined (legacy Project header only, funding stays unknown) when the project is empty, the pin source is none, the served mark is absent, or the project is not ASCII-safe. The only user-accepted limitation is a still-running task collected by the old daemon, spool bound to P1, with a different P2 now resolving. A fresh task that resolves no project (pinAttribution pins {project:'', source:'none'} permanently) or has a non-ASCII project is not covered by that acceptance. Probe r7 shows a funding request without Project-Source cannot be used to close it without backend change.
findings.impact: EPMCDME-17410 AC1 (Cowork session stored with subscription_type codemie) is partial for those sessions; reachability of each case against real users was not independently confirmed beyond the code path.
findings.recommendation: Human decision: either accept in writing that no-project and non-ASCII-project Cowork sessions are out of AC1 (the baseline already drops such projects), or declare funding for them in a way the backend routes correctly. Do not extend the accepted upgrade edge case to cover them implicitly.
